entries.test: Whether published replications or evaluations from around February 2024 showed the generative AI systems in question (e.g., ChatGPT/DALL-E on negation prompts like 'no elephant') often failing to follow simple instructions.
entries.note: The example in the post appears to be multimodal or image generation (the elephant prompts), so 'large language model systems' is a slightly loose label for the target. 'Reliably' is vague, but the plain reading is that the systems fail often on simple prompts.
